issue.title: RefsPanelModelTests.testTabSwitchUsesTheSwitcherPreselectionOnceOnTheNextShow times out and selects the wrong row
issue.description: Repo: bob-mac-capture. Proposing bead: bob-cli-a8 landing audit. The test times out waiting for its model condition, then lines 3085 and 3092 select ref/books/small_book.md instead of ref/blogs/small_opened.md. It exercises selecting a Highlights tab then the one-time preselection on the next ordinary .library show. Investigate the fake reader/opener sequencing against remembered Tabs selection, and preserve the separate new .panelSwitch keep-view contract. Reproduces identically in macOS CI runs 39499997621 at 785508c before the first epic commit, 39505351980 at e99cec6, and 39511067813 at 1d5735a. Root cause unconfirmed, so size large. Not among bob-cli-8j's six listed failures; that task is related only by test target. No causal active epic. Evidence artifact contains diagnostics and run URLs.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical failure on three consecutive observed states: pre-epic 785508c (run 39499997621), e99cec6 (39505351980), and 1d5735a (39511067813). No passing rerun observed.

issue.creation_reason: Landing bob-cli-a8 revealed a repeatable pre-existing macOS CI failure that is not covered by the existing node-specific task scopes. Track it separately so the epic does not absorb unrelated baseline work.
